lesson_aliases.interpretation: Advisory guidance remains subordinate to scope and accepted authority.
Design research does not transfer external identity, project facts or asset authorship.
Write an original design specification with semantic token roles, type hierarchy, component states and responsive constraints before implementation.
Add a component/runtime only when a concrete user job outweighs dependency and maintenance cost.
Ensure focus/keyboard and visible direct actions match pointer affordances.
Scope animation resource lifecycle and retain useful static/reduced-motion content.
Judge meaningful hierarchy in settled static views before enhancing with motion.
Recompose desktop panels into a meaningful mobile reading/action order rather than shrinking the desktop arrangement.
Scale discovery controls to collection size and evidenced findability needs; do not add broad archive filters to a tiny collection.
Validate a detector finding against the actual rendered pattern; rejected false positives remain recorded.
Implemented motion and partial diagnostics do not prove numerical performance or certification.
Comparison controls require truthful paired inputs; unrelated reference photos cannot imply before/after or one building.
Review responsive image crops/loading/container intent independently from performance scores.
Record text, first-viewport visual and interaction evidence as different inspection scopes.
Remove a proposed preview interaction when actual visual acceptance fails; preserve its rejected historical decision.
